selection_rationale: Representative sources covering Brazilian survey-based nutrition, evolutionary algorithm comparisons, meal representation, health/environment compromise, departure modeling and demographic food-group interpretation. This is a focused comparison, not an exhaustive review or a numerical ranking.

rows.label: Brazilian nutrient-constrained diets
rows.input_method: Brazilian adult survey; 68 aggregated foods; linear programming.
rows.objectives_constraints: Minimum departure from observed mean intake; nutrient goals with relaxation of limiting constraints.
rows.evaluation_scope: Population dietary changes and nutrient gaps; no evolutionary-method comparison.

evidence.pdf_filename: Food choices to meet nutrient recommendations for the adult Brazilian population based on the linear programming approach.pdf

rows.label: Evolutionary school lunches
rows.input_method: School-lunch dishes; nondominated sorting genetic algorithm II, strength Pareto evolutionary algorithm 2 and adaptive indicator-based evolution.
rows.objectives_constraints: Cost and course/food-group repetition; nutritional constraints.
rows.evaluation_scope: Algorithm and hypervolume comparisons across menu instances; school-age requirements.

evidence.pdf_filename: Application of Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms for Planning Healthy and Balanced School Lunches.pdf

rows.label: Bilevel daily menus
rows.input_method: Four daily meals; nondominated sorting genetic algorithm II selects foods and mathematical programming sets quantities.
rows.objectives_constraints: Cost and concentration across foods/meals; nutritional constraints.
rows.evaluation_scope: Pareto menu examples with fictitious costs; a bilevel recommender rather than four matched optimizer families.

evidence.pdf_filename: Multi-Objective Bilevel Recommender System for Food Diets.pdf

rows.label: Health/environment compromises
rows.input_method: French cohort; 96 food groups; multicriteria compromise optimization.
rows.objectives_constraints: Health and environmental-pressure indices; alternative acceptability bounds.
rows.evaluation_scope: Pareto trajectory and food changes; health-risk and environmental scores differ from nutrient deviation.

evidence.pdf_filename: Balancing human and planetary health through multicriteria optimization Insights from the NutriNet-Sant´e cohort.pdf

rows.label: Finnish diets with mycoprotein
rows.input_method: Finnish reference diets; quadratic optimization compared with a piecewise linear model.
rows.objectives_constraints: Weighted departure from observed consumption; nutritional constraints and progressive emissions reductions.
rows.evaluation_scope: Male/female food-group changes and sensitivity; ingredient and acceptability scenarios.

evidence.pdf_filename: Designing Culturally Acceptable, Nutritious, and Low Environmental Impact Finnish Diets with Mycoprotein A Novel Optimization Approach.pdf

rows.label: Observed-diet heuristic refinement
rows.input_method: Brazilian observed individual diets; mutation, crossover and fitness-based selection.
rows.evaluation_scope: Nutrient and food-group outcomes across demographic groups; no matched four-algorithm Pareto comparison.

evidence.pdf_filename: A Bio-Inspired AI Approach to Personalized Dietary Planning for Chronic Disease Prevention.pdf

rows.label: Multi-agent dietary refinement
rows.input_method: Brazilian individual diets; multi-agent interaction and evolutionary refinement.
rows.evaluation_scope: Demographic and food-group comparisons; the younger reference age is 25, rather than 30.

evidence.pdf_filename: Intelligent Systems for Public Health A Multi-Agent System for Culturally Tailored Dietary Policy.pdf
